entities.name: Query ferrochelatase
observations: The 319-residue sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt ferrochelatase B0BTL7 from Actinobacillus pleuropneumoniae serotype 3.
Predicted molecular mass is 36,242.722 Da and theoretical pI is 5.376.
Pfam Ferrochelatase domain PF00762.25 spans residues 5–318 with i-Evalue 1e-117.
The enzyme is assigned EC 4.98.1.1 and is localized to the cytoplasm in the exact reference annotation.

entities.name: B0BTL7
observations: Reviewed Actinobacillus pleuropneumoniae serotype 3 ferrochelatase; exact sequence match to the query.
Catalyzes ferrous insertion into protoporphyrin IX.
Annotated to cytoplasm, protoporphyrin ferrochelatase activity, and heme biosynthetic process.

entities.name: Protoheme biosynthesis
observations: Ferrochelatase catalyzes the terminal step converting protoporphyrin IX and Fe2+ into heme b.

entities.name: RHEA:22584
observations: Reference reaction is heme b + 2 H+ = protoporphyrin IX + Fe2+ as recorded in the retrieved Rhea mapping; the physiological forward direction is ferrous insertion into protoporphyrin IX to form heme b.
